mapper.sql: SELECT c.carton_id, c.request_id, c.carton_code, c.requested_code, c.outbound_id, o.reference_id AS fba_shipment_id, p.status, c.operator_id, c.created_at, b.fba_box_number, COALESCE(b.active, FALSE) AS binding_active, b.bound_by, b.bound_at FROM wms_fba_carton c JOIN wms_outbound_package p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.package_id = c.carton_id JOIN wms_outbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND o.order_id = c.outbound_id LEFT JOIN wms_fba_box_binding b ON b.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND b.carton_id = c.carton_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_fba_carton(tenant_id, carton_id, request_id, carton_code, requested_code, outbound_id, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{c.cartonId}, #{c.requestId}, #{c.cartonCode}, #{c.requestedCode}, #{c.outboundId}, #{c.operatorId}, #{c.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND c.outbound_id = #{filter.outboundId} AND c.carton_id = (SELECT i.carton_id FROM wms_fba_box_identifier i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND i.box_code = #{filter.cartonCode})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_sales_package_pick pp JOIN wms_actual_pick k ON k.tenant_id = pp.tenant_id AND k.request_id = pp.pick_id JOIN wms_outbound_allocation a ON a.tenant_id = k.tenant_id AND a.allocation_id = k.allocation_id JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND l.batch_no = a.batch_no JOIN wms_inbound_order r ON r.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND r.order_id = l.order_id WHERE pp.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND pp.package_id = c.carton_id AND a.batch_no = #{filter.batchNo} AND r.reference_id = #{filter.purchaseOrderId})
ORDER BY c.created_at, c.carton_id
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_fba_box_binding b SET active = FALSE WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND b.fba_box_number = #{box} AND b.active AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_outbound_package p WHERE p.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND p.package_id = b.carton_id AND p.status = 'CANCELLED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_fba_box_binding(tenant_id, carton_id, fba_box_number, bound_by, bound_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{carton}, #{box}, #{operator}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO wms_fba_box_identifier(tenant_id, box_code, carton_id, kind) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{code}, #{carton}, 'INTERNAL') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO wms_fba_box_identifier AS i(tenant_id, box_code, carton_id, kind) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{code}, #{carton}, 'FBA') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, box_code) DO UPDATE SET carton_id = EXCLUDED.carton_id WHERE i.carton_id = EXCLUDED.carton_id OR (i.kind = 'FBA' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_outbound_package p WHERE p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND p.package_id = i.carton_id AND p.status = 'CANCELLED'))
